newsitem.title: POLAND: Dana to produce car filters in Poland.
newsitem.headline: Dana to produce car filters in Poland.

text.p: Dana Corp. plans to set up a joint venture with Polish company Filtron to produce car filters, the Gazeta Wybocza daily reported on Saturday.
The paper quoted a statement from the U.S. company as saying that Dana would have a 75 percent of shares in the venture, called Wix-Filtron.
Filtron, Poland's second biggest car filter maker, would hold the rest.
Filtron, based in the central town of Gostynin, employs 230 workers. The firm expects its sales to reach $17 million in 1997, Gazeta Wyborcza said.
